carries: the run's log said it: eleven of fourteen rejections were a dish the model had already written — three times sweet-potato-oat-bites in ONE run. Two causes, both mine: the commission repeated its lines because a six-profile rotation loops before ten lines, and the prompt never told the model what existed — the pool went to the validator, after the fact, never to the writer

the commission no longer repeats a line in a run, and each line carries a hero ingredient drawn from the catalogue in rotation: salmon at 24 months and white beans at 6 cannot both come back as sweet-potato patties
the prompt now names what exists and what this very run has just written, as a block the model must not rewrite
no build: the generation is Node
